zh.text: 新加坡国立大学是新加坡的公立研究型大学，前身为1905年成立的海峡殖民地医学学校。1980年，新加坡大学与南洋大学合并，正式组建新加坡国立大学。学校主校区位于皇后镇肯特岗，毗邻新加坡科学园。大学提供涵盖科学、医学、工程、法律、艺术及商业等多个领域的学位课程。

en.text: The National University of Singapore is a public research university in Singapore. Its origins trace back to the Straits Settlements and Federated Malay States Government Medical School, founded in 1905. The current institution was established in 1980 through the merger of the University of Singapore and Nanyang University. The main campus is located in the Kent Ridge subzone of Queenstown. The university offers degree programmes in sciences, medicine, engineering, law, arts, and business.
